page.overview:
What is Brave Olivine?

The |Bureibu Asagi-gou|Brave Asagi}} is the airship headquarters of the Rising Volt Tacklers. It serves as the current base for Liko and Roy. The Brave Olivine first appears in the sky near Indigo Academy, where Anne and Liko took notice of its presence.

Anne notes how unusual it was for a airship to appear. During the end of the semester, Professor Friede brings Liko to the airship in order to escape the Explorers. After the Rising Volt Tacklers disbanded, the Brave Olivine fell into retirement.

Orla still kept the ship in perfect condition, despite refusing to let it fly ever again. After the Rising Volt Tacklers officially reunited, the Brave Olivine once again became their base of operations.
